description:
Title: Chainsaw

You produce custom chainsaws on demand.
Your chainsaws have at least 5 properties such as length of the "guide bar" (Schwertlaenge), chain width, electric or motor chainsaw.
After your customer told you the properties, you can start ordering the parts from various online sources (in parallel).
After the parts arrive you have to do a manual inspection of all parts, and then assemble the parts.
During production, you regularly send updates to your customer.
After producing the first saw you send it to your customer.
If he likes it, the rest of his order are produced.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Chainsaw"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChainsawProperties" name="Chainsaw properties">
    <bpmn:documentation>The customer provides at least five properties, including guide bar length (Schwertlaenge), chain width, and whether the chainsaw is electric or motor-driven.</bpmn:documentation>
  </bpmn:message>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsOrder" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsDelivery" name="Parts delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerUpdate" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Feedback on first chainsaw"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chainsaw" name="Produce custom chainsaws on demand" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PropertiesReceived" name="Customer provides chainsaw properties">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_OrderParts</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PropertiesReceived" messageRef="Message_ChainsawProperties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_OrderParts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderParts_PartsArrive</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PartsArrive" name="All parts arrive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderParts_PartsArrive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PartsArrive_Inspect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PartsArrive" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Manually inspect all parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PartsArrive_Inspect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inspect_Assemble</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleParts" name="Assemble the parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inspect_Assemble</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assemble_ProductionSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" name="Produce and send updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assemble_ProductionSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_ProduceFirst</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SendUpdates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceFirstSaw" name="Produce the first chainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_ProduceFirst</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProduceFirst_SendFirst</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstSaw" name="Send the first chainsaw to the customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProduceFirst_SendFirst</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendFirst_WaitFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitFeedback" name="Receive customer feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendFirst_WaitFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerLikesFirstSaw" name="Does the customer like the first chainsaw?" default="Flow_NotLiked"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws" name="Produce the remaining chainsaws">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Liked_ProduceRemaining</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProduceRemaining_ProductionMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductionMerge" name="Continue production flow">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProduceRemaining_ProductionMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotLiked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ProductionMerge_UpdatesJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRegularUpdates" name="Send regular updates to the customer during production">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_SendUpdates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendUpdates_UpdatesJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">productionIsOngoing</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin" name="Production and updates complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ProductionMerge_UpdatesJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendUpdates_UpdatesJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdatesJoin_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProductionComplete" name="Production complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdatesJoin_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_OrderParts" sourceRef="StartEvent_PropertiesReceived" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderParts_PartsArrive" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Event_PartsArrive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PartsArrive_Inspect" sourceRef="Event_PartsArrive" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Assemble" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assemble_ProductionSplit" sourceRef="Task_AssembleParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ProduceFirst" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_ProduceFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SendUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_SendRegularUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProduceFirst_SendFirst" sourceRef="Task_ProduceFirstSaw" targetRef="Task_SendFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendFirst_WaitFeedback" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Event_WaitFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Decision" sourceRef="Event_WaitFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Liked_ProduceRemaining" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesFirstSaw" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerLikesFirstSaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLiked" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesFirstSaw" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProduceRemaining_ProductionMerge" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemainingSaws" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductionMerge_UpdatesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendUpdates_UpdatesJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendRegularUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdatesJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ProductionComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_Chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineSources" name="Online parts sources"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Customer_Properties" name="Chainsaw properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_PropertiesReceived" messageRef="Message_ChainsawProperties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderParts" name="Parts order" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Participant_OnlineSources" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartsDelivery" name="Parts delivery" sourceRef="Participant_OnlineSources" targetRef="Event_PartsArrive" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerUpdate" name="Production update" sourceRef="Task_SendRegularUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_CustomerUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback" name="Feedback on first chainsaw" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_WaitFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
